summary: Super League Enterprise filed Amendment No. 1 to a 424B5 prospectus supplement under its S-3 shell to increase its at-the-market equity offering by up to $2.27 million. The company previously sold 475,598 shares for roughly $2.23 million under an August 18, 2026 Sales Agreement with Benchmark and StoneX. The amendment updates the offering amount permitted under General Instruction I.B.6 based on a public float of approximately $13.5 million. This is routine capital-raising under an existing ATM program, not a special situation. No premiums, strategic actions, or event-driven catalysts are present; watch for dilution from continued sales.
